text:
jamie: FYI customer (CobaltHealth) flagged invoice INV-2026-12345 — platform fee and support proration look off. They upgraded support mid-term and we still billed full-year premium platform fee. Need quick fix before renewal churn.
ashley: @jamie can you paste the invoice lines? I want to check what they were billed for vs contract.
jamie: sure. from the invoice PDF extract:
```
INV-2026-12345
Period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31
1x Private Deployment Platform Fee (annual) - $75,000
Support: Premium Tier (billed annual) - $18,000
Adjustment requested: support tier upgrade effective 2026-02-10 (was Standard $9k until 2/9)
Overage: Dedicated GPU-hours true-up - 420 hours @ $12/hr = $5,040
```
jamie: they say sales approved the upgrade on 2026-02-10 and asked for proration of support, not full reversal of platform fee.
laura: I approved the upgrade in email thread; sales contract amendment signed 2026-02-10 says proration to be applied. I added the amendment to SFDC under opportunity OP-7782.
miguel: tagging revenue ops — we should do a credit for the support tier proration ( ~ $9k difference * (324/365) ) and keep platform fee unchanged unless there's a contractual clause. Can you confirm contract language?
ashley: contract clause 4.2 allows pro-rated support changes mid-term. platform fee is annual non-proratable unless we signed amendment.
jamie: customer insists platform fee was on a per-deployment basis and should've been pro-rated after we migrated half their capacity off Private into Dedicated on 2026-03-01 — they attached a migration order.
miguel: do we have migration docs? if they moved capacity, that affects committed capacity charges, not the platform fee unless we explicitly reduced bundle. Need ops confirmation.
laura: ops confirmed migration (ticket OP-2345) moved 50% capacity to Dedicated on 2026-03-01 for 90 days as a pilot; no formal contract change was executed by sales.
jamie: customer asked for two things: 1) proration of support back to Standard for 1/1-2/9, then Premium from 2/10 onward, 2) a credit for platform fee for the pilot period (50% of platform fee * 90/365) or a billing note while pilot was active.
ashley: proposed approach: apply support proration credit now, create a temporary credit memo for platform fee pilot request and route to legal + sales to confirm whether we can honor a one-off credit. suggest hold final platform credit until contract sign-off.
miguel: run numbers and create a credit memo draft: support credit calc: (Premium - Standard) = $9,000 annual difference. Days to credit: 40 days (1/1–2/9) so credit = 9000 * 40/365 = $986. 
laura: platform pilot credit calc (if approved): 75,000 * 0.5 * 90/365 = $9,246.58 approx.
jamie: customer requested immediate account-level credit to avoid payment dispute and not delay renewal.
ashley: billing-bot please generate provisional credit memo for support proration for $986 and put on account CUST-COBALT. Include reference INV-2026-12345 and note "pending platform credit review".
billing-bot: automated note: Credit memo CM-2026-789 generated for $986. Reference: INV-2026-12345. Status: pending approval from revenue-ops.
miguel: I'll review CM-2026-789 and route to finance lead for approval. For the platform fee, I'll escalate to legal + laura to see if we can treat the pilot as an amendment waiver.
laura: I can sign an amendment for a temporary concession if legal ok, but we should log this as a one-time commercial concession and record SAR reason.
jamie: customer asked for a payment hold on the disputed invoice until 3/10. Can we allow net-30 hold?
ashley: we can set a payment hold for 30 days for strategic accounts. I'll set it and notify collections.
miguel: action items: 1) finance: approve CM-2026-789 (support proration) — assigned to @miguel; 2) legal+sales: decide platform fee pilot credit — assigned to @laura + legal; 3) ops: attach migration ticket to invoice record — assigned to @jamie; 4) collections: apply payment hold until 2026-03-10 — assigned to @ashley.
laura: noted. I'll ping legal and loop sales ops.
jamie: customer happy with support proration being granted fast, asked us to expedite platform decision. They want written confirmation by EOD 2026-02-20.
miguel: I'll prioritize review; if legal needs more time we'll at least provide a timeline.
ashley: thanks everyone — I'll update the customer thread and close the loop once CM is posted and payment hold is set. :white_check_mark:
